Create an automatic privacy spec

ds.flower.privacy.auto.Rd

The automatic privacy policy is resolved at run time after server capabilities are inspected. It chooses prefer when all connected servers report Secure Aggregation support; otherwise it chooses fallback. Explicit privacy specs remain available for production deployments that require a fixed policy.

Usage

ds.flower.privacy.auto(
  prefer = "clinical_default",
  fallback = "trusted_internal"
)

Arguments

prefer

Character privacy profile to use when SecAgg is available.

fallback

Character privacy profile to use otherwise.

Value

A dsflower_privacy object with mode = "auto".
